title: Mochizuki Honami — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Hello and welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let me see...
Please give me fifteen apple pies.

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Fifteen apple pies, right?
Thanks for always buying from us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Siiigh...
I'm sooo hungry...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mhm? Is that Honami over there?
Hi ho, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah?! E-Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, that smells delicious!
Is that a bag full of apple pies I spy with my little eye?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes... I like apple pies.
And the apple pies from this shop just taste so good...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. This is very useful information♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
Can I have a thousand apple pies, please?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (One thousand?!)

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: D-Did you just say a-a thousand?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, one thousand apple pies, please!

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Umm, I'm very sorry, but we just finished selling all the apple pies we had available...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh... I bought the last ones?)

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
We're baking fresh ones now...
They should be available for sale in about an hour.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: O-One...whole...hour!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I can't wait that long...
Ugh... My stomach's already growling like crazy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Soon I will deflate and become as thin as a fluttery piece of paper...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ugh... Will I get blown away by the wind when that happens?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... It was my fault for buying up the entire stock, so would you like to have one of mine?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eek!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-If you don't mind, that is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll take it! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You saved my life, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's my pleasure.
Ah, there are some empty seats over there. Shall we sit down there and eat?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here.
It's very hot, so be careful not to burn your tongue.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okaaay! Whoa, hot!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A-Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nom nom! Yeah, it's hot but not too hot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And it's super delish!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe, I'm glad you think so.
I really love the apple pies here too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ah...
Excuse me for a bit, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
There's apple pie crust on your cheeks...
Okay, I've removed it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You can use these wet tissues too, if you need them. Oh, by the way, would you like some juice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Great, I'll get something for you too then.
Hm... Are you okay with orange juice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Perfect hospitality!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Orange juice, please!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get that for you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ahh, that was delicious...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It was pure bliss!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The apple pie was good, and you treated me so nicely too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll repay this apple pie of perfect hospitality one day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Farewell, and see you tomorrow!
Thanks again☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's been a while since I was able to really sit down and just enjoy an apple pie without thinking too much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So thank you, actually, Emu.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(This music... It must be the brass band.
How nostalgic.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was in the percussion section of the brass band in middle school too...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Honami, you're so...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Whose side are you on, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I never want to remember that time again!)
Hu-hum hu-hum♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is someone humming?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's the same melody the brass band was playing... But who's humming?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Huh? It came from somewhere nearby, but where—)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ahh?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What... Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gotcha!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Very good. Honami's reaction to my surprise is as fantastic as Tsukasa and the girl from class A.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Tsukasa? Girl from class A?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait. But it's not really a gotcha if I only manage to make them surprised, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, what?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Anyway, why were you looking so upset just now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I was not.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You sure?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Was she trying to cheer me up because she saw me looking a little gloomy?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... I was in the brass band in middle school, so I had a trip down memory lane, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
That's all. Really.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope my smile is convincing enough...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wh-What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have to go to the stage now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
S-Stage?
Oh, you mean in Phoenix Wonderland?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami!
Once our show's ready, you have to come watch, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then you'll definitely be able to smile from the heart!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
See you around, Honami!
Bye bye☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello! Sorry, I got held up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No worries. We've still got to wait for the others anyway.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is it just me and you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Ichika and Saki should be on their way, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd hope so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, um... They're running late, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They'll get here sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sure they will...
Oh, I got a message from Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's it say?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That she and Saki have just left the school.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She had a class rep meeting, and Saki had to stay longer for classroom duty.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmph. Ah, I got one too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's from Saki. She says they're rushing over but it's going to take them at least fifteen minutes to get here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Fifteen minutes? If we were here all together, it wouldn't feel like very long at all but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (When it's just me and her, it seems like forever.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We've made up but it's still so awkward for me to talk to Shiho...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wonder if she thinks that about me too?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But we can't just wait in silence...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Don't you want to get your kit ready?
Drums take the longest to set up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah, right. I'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Phew... She spoke to me first.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, I can't just leave it like this!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to work on my attitude too, if we are to stay together.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, would you mind if...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Would I mind what?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If...we did some rhythm pattern practice together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to make sure I'm following your lead well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Does she hate the idea? Hmm, she doesn't look angry.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't let me lead.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wh-Why not?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're both doing the rhythmic section, but you don't need to match up what I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It would only make our music sound dull.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's you setting the tempo for the entire band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right, of course...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's my problem, always trying to adjust myself to others...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I think I can gradually change that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm ready to start playing whenever. How about you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm all set up and ready too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, you start. I'll come in after you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure! Let's do this!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Lady
rows.Line:
Free coupons!
Please take one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Um, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's for the game arcade, one free go at the claw machine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's cool! Why don't we go to the arcade and try our luck?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. I'm not working today anyway.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, but I don't want to stay long...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... I'm sorry, but I have to go to work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's too bad. Next time we should all go together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That'll be nice. Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I better check my messages before I get on the subway... Phew, Ms. Yoisaki replied.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Today it's going to be...cleaning and cooking. I'll have to stop by the supermarket...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Cleaning? Cooking?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What sort of job does Hona do?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Dunno. I didn't even know she had a job.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Neither did I.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You want to know what I do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. It was news to me yesterday that you had a job too. What sort of thing is it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is it something you don't want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's nothing embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Who's this Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You cook and clean as part of your job?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You don't work at a diner or a karaoke place, do you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not so many questions at once! I'll tell you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I do housekeeping.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Housekeeping?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you go to people's houses and cook and clean for them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I've always been good at housework, so I thought I could make some money off it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: At first, I was going to apply for waitressing positions, but a friend told me it's very stressful work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I asked my mom for advice, and she told me that some of her clients use this housekeeping service.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Your mom's a stylist, right?
She works with models and the like?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's right. So I thought, since her clients have good opinions of this service, maybe it would be worth applying.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me of when you used to volunteer at a care home. You said then that you'd like that to be your job one day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did, yes. I think that's when I realized I enjoyed looking after people.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So you go to strangers' houses and do house chores?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you do it while they're in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You missed a spot, clean it again! Hyeh hyeh hyeh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you get bullied by tyrannical employers like that?! I saw that happen a lot in TV soaps I was watching while in the hospital!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's not like that at all.
I'm currently working for a girl one year older than us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Say that again?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Your employer's a high school student?
I bet there's an interesting story to that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even kids who live in their own apartments don't normally hire housekeepers...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I'm sorry, but I can't tell you about her personal situation. I've got to respect her privacy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course you do. Sorry for prying.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She sounds all right, but what if you got called to a house and it turned out your employer was a lecherous old man or something!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The agency lets us search for potential employers based on various criteria, so I make sure it's only people I'd be comfortable with.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You can choose employers by gender, location, the scope of help with housework they require, things like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... It sounds like a decent agency!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If it wasn't, her mom wouldn't have recommended it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry for bothering you with all these questions, Hona.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's nice that you were so concerned about me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm really enjoying this job, so you don't need to worry!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can't introduce Ms. Yoisaki to them, or them to Ms. Yoisaki because we have a professional relationship...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But it would be great if we got the opportunity to all meet up someday.)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to go for a cleanup committee meeting later. I should tell my club seniors that I'll be late today.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (There's still some time until morning homeroom starts. I should go look for the club seniors before...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha!
Nah, this wouldn't look good on me!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Ah... That's Saki's voice.
She's already in the classroom?)
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: That's not true! You probably wouldn't choose this color yourself, but I bet you'd still look good in it, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm... When you put it that way, it makes me feel like I should try it out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki's already getting along so well with her classmates. She's amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(She looks to be in the pink of health too.
I haven't seen her smile so brightly in such a long time...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can't believe I just left after our eyes met like that... What am I doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, good morning.
Sorry...I have to go now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah...
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Morning, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Hey, are you okay, Honami?
You don't look so good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line:
She's right. You seem a little down.
Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, don't worry. Everything's just fine.
After school

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Honami, let's go back together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: I must've flunked that pop quiz in math class today. It was so tough!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I found it difficult too.
I need to do a review when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, thanks for waiting!
I finished the teacher's errand!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's fine, I wasn't waiting that long.
How's your health? Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm feeling great! So you have to keep your promise and accompany me later!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. You said you wanted to buy something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! And I brought along my life savings for it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come on, to the musical instrument store we go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Musical instrument store?
Are the two of them going to start a band together?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That sounds fun...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Hm? What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, no. It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Sounds fun, huh...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We played a song together with Miku that day...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The apple pie I had yesterday...
We used to eat that together in the past, too.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Honami? Something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Sorry, I'm coming!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Hey, you're really out of sorts today.
You sure everything's okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I was just thinking about the questions in the workbook, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Okay? Well, if you're sure...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'm quite sure. Let's go back.
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That went pretty well just now.
Don't forget this feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay then, one more time while I still remember!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, that felt great!
We've gotten better, haven't we?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, a little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? Only a little?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were at elementary school level the other day, but we've hit high school level today, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... After all, we were downright terrible the first time we played for Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. We've definitely gotten better since then, though.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your first mistake was using that as a benchmark.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, to you, high school level just means we're good for the school festival or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No proper live house is going to allow a band like that to perform on their stage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Live house...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That sounds nice. I would love to perform in front of an audience one day as a proper band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll need to have major milestones like that if we're going to become a real band together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not at our current level we aren't.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
For now, let's practice hard and get better.
And then eventually...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait! There's something else we need besides good skills!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Costumes! We don't have stage costumes, yet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Just wear something casual.
The audience will be there to listen to our songs, not see our clothing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But if we're going to be performing in front of an audience, it'll be much better to have proper costumes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... I think I may know where to find some good ones...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Does everyone have a bit of time after this?
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, Luka and Miku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, everyone, and welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome! Here to practice again today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, I wanted to make sewing patterns of the costumes we wear when performing in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sewing patterns?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That means...you intend to make another set of these costumes for yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that even possible?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! It won't be the exact same costume, but making something similar is definitely possible.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona's in the home economics club, so she can cook and sew really well!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds lovely.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, how do you make sewing patterns?
Can I see?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ichika's belt is like this...
Oh, so that's how this ornament is designed...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm not very familiar with tailoring myself, but you're just drawing out the sewing pattern directly without making any sketches of the costume design first?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, well...
It's because Hona can't really draw very well...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona has a very unique way of sketching pictures...
You could say she's a master artist...in a sense.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wouldn't a master artist be great at drawing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Her drawings are truly something else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, quiet!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I heard everything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, that's all of us. As for the boots and accessories, we'll just have to search around for similar ones.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm, if only we could just bring those clothes back with us. Then you wouldn't have to go through the trouble of making them all over again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Even so, it's always good to have backups.
Also, I really enjoy such work, so it's fine!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you're going to be making them from scratch, you should add in your own preferences too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Since you'll be getting your own boots and accessories, wouldn't it be more fun to buy something that you liked?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, you do make a good point.
Shall we all do that together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that you've got the perfect costumes, go out there and sing the song of your feelings to as many people as you can!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We will!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hooooona♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ah! Saki!
You've recovered from your cold already?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! I'm as healthy as can be, as you can see!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's good. I'm glad you're all better now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks for taking me home the other day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now I'm all recovered, and my appetite is great too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Speaking of appetite, do you wanna have lunch together today? I'll ask Ichi and Shiho too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. I'll see you at lunch time, then.
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Morning.
You were talking with Tenma just now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh?
Yes, but how did you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Because Tenma called your name so loudly, we could hear it all the way from the classroom.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: She said something about being as healthy as can be, too.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Actually, that caught my attention somewhat.
Did Tenma fall sick again?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, a while ago.
Oh, but she's completely fine now.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Okay, that's great!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks for your concern for her, though.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Huh? What's with that weird grin on your face?
Hehe... Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Hey! It's not THAT funny!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: But it must be nice to be together with your childhood friends like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Well, I had a childhood friend too, but she moved away when we were still in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: We wrote to each other for a while, but one day, she just stopped replying.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: That's why I think it's really nice that you're getting along so well with your childhood friends even now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I had no idea...but thank you for telling me about your experience.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha. You did tell us what was important to you too! So I thought it's probably okay to share mine.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, you're such a nice girl!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hey, stop that!
Stop clinging to me!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: I would never have stopped writing to such a nice girl like you! Right, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Both of them are so kind.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (After entering high school, I managed to patch things up with Ichika, Shiho and Saki.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And because of that, I even made these wonderful friends in class. I'm so grateful.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to keep treasuring everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate A
rows.Line: Hey, we should probably studying for that first period quiz.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: Huh? Quiz? What're we having in the first period again?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mathematics.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line:
No way! I haven't done any studying for it at all!
H-Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure. I'll tell you what sections are more likely to appear in the quiz.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate B
rows.Line: I knew I could count on you, Honami! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, you're most welcome.
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Snacks, check!
Drinks, check!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, Hona, serve the main dish!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Main dish?
I thought Honami brought photos?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Putting it this way helps us to get into the mood!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here. The photos from the planetarium the other day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow... That's a lot of photos.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Hona, was it tough for you to get these printed?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not at all! There are self-service photo printing booths in most major electronics stores these days.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's easy to print photos from your smartphone with them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, it's so easy that I ended up printing too many because I wanted them all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's nice. Ah... Hehe, look at this one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki, your eyes are half-closed here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Hey, why did you put this weird-looking face of mine right in the middle of everything?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You didn't have to print bad shots like this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm sorry, but when I saw it, it was just too funny to ignore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's it! I'm gonna look for funny face pictures of everyone now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, let's see who can find the weirdest photo first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're on! Ready... Go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You found something, Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Not really a funny picture.
It's a picture of Miku and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I printed it out because I was going to pass it to them the next time we go to SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aww... Both of them are smiling.
They must've really enjoyed the play-planetarium experience!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I was also thinking of making a photo book of sorts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So that we can leave some tangible memories behind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, great idea! I should do something like that for the memories of my youth life too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but how many pages will be enough? I need to put in my memories with Ichi, Shiho, and Hona, as well as those with my classmates...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also need to leave space for memories with future friends from other classes, and then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why are you making space for people who aren't even your friends yet?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I have a good feeling we'll become friends soon!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's nice. Which classes are they from?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: From Shiho and Hona's classes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How so?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I remember. You know Minori from my class, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! My first friend outside my own class!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have this part-time job I applied for because the uniforms were so cute, and Minori's working there too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I did hear about that. Your shifts overlapped for the first time on your third day of work or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup yup! We were so surprised to see each other!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hanasato is pretty close to Kiritani from our class, so we meet her in school quite often too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly! So I'm going to use Operation: Friend of My Friend Is Also My Friend to make a whole new network of friends♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why, Hona, you should absolutely introduce your friends to me too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki is so amazing.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've always thought I should cherish both the friends in my class as well as Saki, Ichika, and Shiho.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I would view them differently. Friends on the one side, and then Saki, Ichika, and Shiho on the other.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But...there's no reason to separate them like this at all.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hey, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll be asking my class friends to have lunch together one of these days. Would you like to join us then?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? You mean us?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I think it would be nice for us to eat together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If it's okay with you, we don't mind at all, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course I'm joining! I can't wait, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. This is Honami Mochizuki from Class 1-B. I'm here to talk about the choir recital.

rows.Speaker: Choir Recital Chairman
rows.Line: Okay. Has your class decided on its free choice selection?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're going to sing Smile Tomorrow Too.

rows.Speaker: Choir Recital Chairman
rows.Line: Smile Tomorrow Too is a great choice, but also very difficult. Are you sure about this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We decided on the song together as a class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'm truly sorry you had to wait for us because of this...

rows.Speaker: Choir Recital Chairman
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. Your class wasn't the only one that took a while to decide.

rows.Speaker: Choir Recital Chairman
rows.Line:
You've got your work cut out for you,
but thank you for your song choice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, yes...! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We'll need to come up with a practice schedule that works for everyone after this.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Also, I'm feeling a little drained.
Maybe I'll take a little detour before going back.)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sigh... I'm just so glad it all worked out somehow...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Everyone has stuff going on in their lives, so we should just go for something simpler.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: But can't you see we're trying to drum up some enthusiasm here? You really should've kept all those demoralizing excuses to yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (When they started arguing, I didn't know what was going to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please allow me to say something before we begin.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad I mustered up the courage to do it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad I trusted my classmates...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And it was all because...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're making it pretty obvious you think your current friends would turn on you given half a chance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It was a because of Shiho and MEIKO.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I've figured it out. What I needed was the courage to speak my mind... And the courage to trust my friends.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
There she is!
Honamiii!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Honami! We were looking for you!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We thought something happened because you were taking so long to get back!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu... Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Wah! Honami, why are you crying?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
What happened, Honami?
Did the committee say something mean to you?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Was it because we took too long to choose our song?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That wasn't Honami's fault! Who do they think they are?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! You didn't do anything wrong!
Hnng! I'm so angry now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Me too! I'm gonna go give that committee a piece of my mind!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hang on! W-Wait, please!
You've got it all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm crying out of relief because we finally all managed to agree on a song...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, really. Thank you all for being so concerned about me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then that's great!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But if you were sent to look for me, it must mean that everyone in the class is waiting for us, right? We should hurry back.
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for taking so long, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Welcome back, Mochizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Yes. I'm finally back.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We've been trying to come up with a schedule together while you were gone.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: It's still pretty rough but can you take a look and tell us what you think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You did all of this...?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Honestly, some of us still aren't in the mood yet, but that doesn't mean we want you to do all the heavy lifting.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We'll help out with whatever we can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! Let's make the recital fun for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone.
Let's start talking about our practice schedule!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We're supposed to meet here, I think?
Oh, Hello...! Sorry to keep you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: You must be Mochizuki. Have you been told what the cleanup committee does for beautification week?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We look out for litter, like lunchboxes or wrappers that may've been left behind, and see if students are throwing away their trash properly.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line:
That's right.
Okay, let's start.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's cool and decisive... And if I remember correctly, she's the vice captain of the badminton club too... She's so impressive...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The benches here look like they're being kept clean.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: Yeah. There's no litter around... Aha.

rows.Speaker: Freshman
rows.Line: Ah, that was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: Hey, hold on a second. Yes, you.

rows.Speaker: Freshman
rows.Line: Huh? Um, yes!

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: Always cover your disposable lunchbox before throwing it away, or at least put it in the bag it came in.

rows.Speaker: Freshman
rows.Line: U-Umm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The garbage bins at school aren't covered, so if a box is left exposed, the odor might attract flies and other pests. Please make sure to put it in a bag before throwing these away.

rows.Speaker: Freshman
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: Understand?

rows.Speaker: Freshman
rows.Line: Y-Yes, ma'am! I'll be more careful next time!

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line:
Alright, we're done for today.
Good work, today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. And thank you for letting me tag along!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I just wanted to say that I was impressed by the way you delivered your warning back there.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
I mean... Someone has to say it, right?

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: Also... You helped me back there too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did?

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. I'm looking forward to being paired up with you for another patrol.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's so cool. Hmm... Actually, she reminds me of someone...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, right... She's a lot like Shiho.)
A few days later
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
C'mon! Cheer up already!
You can't mope around like this forever.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hey, Honami. Oh, it's nothing major. She just had a fight with a senior club member and I'm trying to comfort her.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Don't cheapen it like that!
This is a serious matter for me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They're both in the badminton club, right?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you like to talk about it? If you don't mind of course...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Okay... Well, this girl was really breathing down my neck. I mean, it was my fault that I kept making the same mistakes over and over again but...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: She just kept saying, Where are you looking? or, Get your head back in the game! But she could've been a little nicer, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That does sound a little harsh...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Actually, I was kind of surprised too since it was the vice captain saying all these things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The vice captain as in... The one from the cleanup committee?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Her saying those things? My impression of her is that she speaks her mind but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is she being misunderstood? Like Shiho tends to be?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, maybe...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Classmate
rows.Line: Whose side are you on?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Gasp!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I thought I was over that after finally learning to be more honest with my friends...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You okay, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(That's right. I'm fine now.
I can say what I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, I kind of know the badminton club's vice captain because we're both in the cleanup committee.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We talked the other day too and I just can't imagine her acting like that. Could it be that she meant something else when she said that?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh? She might've meant something else?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, right...! Didn't she talk about your opponent's style or tactics or something after she asked, Where are your eyes?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
But I guess you didn't hear that part.
You were already pretty upset by then...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I-I didn't hear anything like that at all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, you could always ask her again or maybe see if someone heard what she said back there. Then you'll definitely understand what she was trying to say.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: Good work today, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: And thank you for the other day too. My clubmate understands what I was trying to tell her now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line: I wanted to tell her to watch the opponent closely and try to predict her next move, so that it's easier to come up with a counter.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line:
But, well... It kinda fell flat.
Sigh... I never choose the right words.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Senior
rows.Line:
I guess I have to watch what I say too, huh?
Anyway, I'm off to the club now, so... Bye!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, bye!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness. They figured things out...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I mustered up the courage to speak up...!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How about that one?
Phenny's Nightmare!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's a haunted house, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's a little dark and creepy just like its name suggests!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's go inside☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So this is the fun sort of haunted house that you and Tsukasa were talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's really fun, I promise♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It looks like your standard haunted house from the outside, but they're saying it's not scary at all so... I should be okay, right?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, it says here to go inside two at a time.
Should we split into pairs?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! I'll go with you, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, the two scaredy cats are going together...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't worry♪ It's a family-friendly attraction.
That means it's okay for kids too, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So there can't be anything in there that would frighten high schoolers like us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Someone's feeling brave, aren't they?
Don't run to me crying to me afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I thought Shiho seemed a bit down just now, but maybe it was just me...)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Alright, is the next pair ready to go in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, we are♪
Let's go, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's a family-friendly attraction... It's fine... I'll be fine!)

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Eeek! A skeleton!
Get away! Get away!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Noooo! Don't come this way...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Are they really going to be okay?
They're screaming so loud, I can hear them out here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That must be because they're having sooo much fun! This haunted house is one of my favorites, so I'm super glad!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How can you say that when they're SCREAMING?!
Saki! Honami! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Honami?
Here, have some juice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shiho.
Where did Saki go...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She went to ride the teacups one more time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. Everyone's so energetic...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess that haunted house really took its toll on you, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, you meanie...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hmm...I guess I was just imagining things...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... That haunted house was really scary, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? I thought you and Saki screaming was the only scary part.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't even know you could be that loud.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Was it really that bad?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If recording videos wasn't prohibited, I might've saved even just the soundtrack of what happened.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, thank goodness you can't do that here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I must have been wrong about her.
She seems like she's enjoying herself.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki and the rest of the bunch should be back soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. Let's go then!
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Lunch time♪ Lunch time♪
What to have for lunch time...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Emu. Are you free now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Time to dig in☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's nice to get to eat lunch with Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Doesn't this wonderful sunshine make you feel like we're on a picnic?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And isn't this the first time that we've ever lunch together? You know, just the two of us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, except that time we had apple pies together at that bakery!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It wasn't even that long ago,
but it somehow feels nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: By the way, I wanted to thank you for showing me your amazing show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The last time we went to Phoenix Wonderland was so long ago, we all just let the kid inside of us sort of take over.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe. That's okay, you were having fun!
Come and play again anytime!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's almost like you're inviting me over to your house.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But since her family owns the theme park, maybe it is her home in a way.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And it must be a very important place to her, judging from how she guided us through the park so thoroughly.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu, maybe you won't remember since it was a while ago...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you once snuck up on me in the corridor and really startled me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup, I remember! You had the best reaction too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ahh?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What... Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gotcha!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess it was funny.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you remember what you asked me after that? About why I looked so upset?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... I was in the brass band in middle school, so I had a trip down memory lane, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
That's all. Really.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope my smile is convincing enough...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I said I was just lost in some memories, but that was a lie.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Back then I was avoiding Saki and the others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's a long story, but would you mind listening?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course not!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Back in junior high, my classmates would often ask me for advice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wanted to be helpful to all of them, but they accused me of being insincere and pretending to be everyone's friend to avoid choosing sides.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They started bullying me by pretending I didn't exist.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika noticed what was happening and became really worried about me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I was too scared to ask her for help,
and I ended up avoiding her instead...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That carried through into high school...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That day you startled me and asked about it,
Saki also tried to talk to me. Several times too,
but I ran away every time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Like you said, it made me upset. Really upset... And I hated myself for treating Saki that way too, but just couldn't help it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But when you asked me if I was really okay, I felt so happy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Telling you about it made me feel so much better.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Back then, I couldn't get myself to tell anyone the truth...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm really grateful that you tried to reach out to me, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe!
You’re super duper welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, and one more thing.
I finally fulfilled our promise too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami!
Once our show's ready, you have to come watch, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then you'll definitely be able to smile from the heart!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did smile from the heart watching your show, like you said.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So thank you for that too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No probs♪
You're super duper extra welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll keep putting on more shows to make more and more people smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So you'll have to come again and again and again to see us on stage!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I promise I will!
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I couldn't focus on classes at all today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I never thought that Saki and Tsukasa would ever fight...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Waaahhhhh!
What do I do, Hona?!
I was so mean to him and...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He's so mad that he won't even look at what I'm sending him...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki's been looking forward to today's Doll Festival party saying that it's her first one since she was little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is there anything I can do to help...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But if even she can't get a hold of Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I know. What if I just went and talked to him in person...?)

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line: Mochizuki, you here? Wanna head to the Cleanup Committee meeting together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, she's from class A...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Right. We have a committee meeting today...)

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line: Mochizuki? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, no. It's nothing.
Just give me a second to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But if I head off to the meeting now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
S-Sorry...!
Can I ask a big favor?!

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line: Hm? A favor?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Well, there's somewhere I absolutely need to be right now...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So would you mind telling the seniors that I won't be able to make it today...?

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line:
That's all? Sure, no problem!
I'll let them know.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line: I mean, some girls just ditch without saying anything, so I'm sure you'll be fine!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much...!
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't believe that I'm actually here now...

rows.Speaker: Female Kamiyama Student A
rows.Line: Her uniform... Isn't she from Miya Girls?

rows.Speaker: Female Kamiyama Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
Maybe she's here to meet someone?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I knew this would happen, but everyone's staring at me...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not supposed to just walk in without permission... What should I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I can't hesitate now...!
It's for Saki's sake...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (P-People were talking about someone from Miya Girls being here and I just assumed it was Emu, but you can't be serious...?!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Kusanagi! Thank goodness...!
I need to ask a huge favor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...! A favor...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I need to talk to Tsukasa right now, but I can't just go in without getting permission first...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A-Alright...
Right, that's what normal people do...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-Nothing...
It's actually sort of okay as long as the teachers don't find you, surprisingly...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
In Emu's case at least...
But why do you need to talk to Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So he got into a fight with his sister and you want them to make up...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, got it. I think I know where he is, so just give me a minute to find him.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Kusanagi!
You're my only hope!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness... All that's left is to actually talk to him...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki sent me a message.
I wonder what she wants...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Hona, have you gotten out of your meeting? If you have, wanna head to my place together...?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hmm... How do I reply to this one...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can't tell her that I skipped the meeting to go find her brother...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I shouldn't do this but...
<Sorry, the meeting won't end for a little while longer. Please go on ahead without me.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I'll have to apologize to her later...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Honami!!!!
Saki! Is Saki alright?!?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You being here means something must've happened to Saki, right?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, yes this is about Saki but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to tell him how Saki actually feels! They need to make up!)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line:
Hey, Mochizuki.
What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I felt that I needed to thank you is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate what you did for me the other day when I had to skip the Cleanup Committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, when you said you had to go somewhere? The seniors didn't seem to care, so I think you're in the clear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, but you were a lifesaver then.
After school
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona, wanna go home together?
Ichi and Shiho said they have work today♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure, that sounds nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to apologize to Saki about that I did too...)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The Doll Festival party was so much fun! Our games of Old Maid and President got so heated too♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so funny how every game of Old Maid had you, Ichika and Tsukasa as the last three in the end too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha...
One game just wouldn't end because we kept picking the joker from each others' hands.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was hoping to apologize to her now, but she's in such a good mood right now. Maybe it can wait until later...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the way, Hona...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I, um... I'm sorry about the other day...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa told me everything.
He said that you went all the way over to his school to tell him that I wasn't mad anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You even skipped your committee meeting to do it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?! How do you know about that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I sort of heard you talking to another girl in my class about the Cleanup Committee and kind of worked things out from there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You had to be so worried about skipping too. I feel terrible for making you do that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I want to apologize, Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, Saki, you don't have to do that!
I'm the one who lied to you about it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Time out! Stop right there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa and I are the ones that started all this, so there is absolutely no reason for you to be apologizing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Lalala! I can't hear you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You were the reason that Tsukasa and I were able to make up in the end, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So thank you, Hona!
Thank you for your concern!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Even though I shouldn't have done what I did but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad I worked up the courage to go through with it.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What's up?
Wait! No apologizing, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know.
So...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're very welcome!
One day, during lunch
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Excuse me.
My name is Honami Mochizuki and I'm here for the cleanup committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami!
I've been looking forward to seeing you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Shizuku.
I've been looking forward to today as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
I heard that band practice has been a little tough lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii's been coming home so late even when she doesn't have to go to work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for keeping her out so late...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho works with each of us during practice and it takes away from her own time too. She ends up having to wait until later to work on her own part...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, don't mind that. I'm sorry for not choosing my words better...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know that Shii's a hard-working girl, so it's not surprising that she's doing that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also know that resting is just as important as practicing, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shizuku...
Thank you for being so considerate of us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right about needing to rest. We'll make sure not to overdo things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've been thinking about performing in our own show, so that might've gotten us a little worked up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A show?
Oh, that's why you've been working so hard!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
When will it be? And where?
I'll definitely come and see it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, but we still don't know yet...
I promise to tell you when we do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm worried about what's going to happen. I always get so nervous in those situations...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? Weren't you in the junior high brass band, Honami? I thought you'd be used to performing in front of others by now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I do have some experience but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The drummer is like the musical foundation that supports the entire band according to Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If I don't play well, I may end up bringing everyone else down with me, and the audience won't know how hard we worked to get on stage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I need to build up my confidence and make sure that I can do my best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't know just how important the drums are...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
There's something else that's been bothering me as well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is it about Shii...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...!
Um, she hasn't been herself lately...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika's under the impression that we're just not at her level yet and she's actually been practicing on her own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm wondering if that's really the whole story. I feel like we don't have the entire picture yet...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii hasn't been able to tell you yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing! Ignore that last part!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure working with Shii is no easy task either, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, she's very hard on us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that's also the reason that I've gotten better and I understand what she's trying to do with us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I feel like we need to do everything we can to make sure her efforts don't go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And for Saki's sake too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's out of the hospital and her life is finally back to normal, so she wants to make up for all the time she lost.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Our band is a part of her memories. I want to cherish it as much as possible!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're such good girls...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Honami, would it be alright if I asked something of you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please... Look after Shii...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is this about her taking on more than she can handle...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Yes, I will. I'll do what I can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much.
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (There aren't any committee meetings today, so I guess we'll all just meet up and head off to practice.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We decided to try to become pros with Shiho, so we need to start practicing more than ever now.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Honami, wanna go home together?
We're going to a karaoke place!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, thank you for the invitation, but I'm sorry. I have band practice today so...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Whoa, today too?!
You guys are working so hard!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, they are! And you're starting to get this aura around you, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: You've pretty much stopped trying to beat around the bush and just clearly say if something can or can't be done.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Exactly. You've even been proposing a lot of ideas during class meetings and stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I have?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, at this rate, I might just end up falling for you, Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What?! No way! I'm not letting you have her!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, you two...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami, about practice today...
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We should probably get going soon. Later, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's okay, I just got here.
Um, did I interrupt something there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, we were just about to wrap things up, so don't worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But where are Saki and Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Their homeroom session hasn't ended yet.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. How about we wait for them in the courtyard?
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The weather's so nice today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I was thinking about something and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, how have things been going between your classmates...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everything's great. We're getting along just fine now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, okay. That's good...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. That reminds me.
Some of the other girls were saying that I'm starting to get some sort of aura.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Something about being able to better express myself and saying what's on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do you think, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Have I changed?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Gasp*! No, wait! Please ignore everything I just said!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... I probably shouldn't be so focused on how other people view me so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The fact that you understand that speaks volumes about you, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
Then it's not all bad.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But an aura?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, if you becoming some sort of idol in your classmates' eyes makes you feel better, then I expect to hear some good beats from you today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no... I just made things harder for myself...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, Shiho.
I actually talked with your sister about what happened the other day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: With Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. She was concerned about how you were feeling then too and we ended up talking about it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: At the end of that conversation, she asked me to look after you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She did...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She did. I didn't understand what she actually meant by that at the time but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Looking back, I now know that she was worried about how we weren't being open with each other. She seemed to already know what was going on then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're probably right.
She wouldn't leave me alone either...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I talked to her after that too about the show, us, everything...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
Hehe. You're lucky to have her as your big sister.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Except how she seems to know more about me than I do myself. That's sort of straight out of a stalker flick.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, Hona, thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry for being so late.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, don't worry about it.
We were having a conversation about Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: More to the point, Honami says she'll drum for us today like never before.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?! Sh-Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, is that so?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cool! I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...! This is getting out of control!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad my committee meeting ended sooner than I expected. I can take my time eating my lunch now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami. Are you on your way back from the Cleanup Committee?

rows.Speaker: Honami
