rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And you're trying to go pro, right? You have to work together, which also means you're not always going to agree on everything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(They're right...
And they've all experienced this before...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, but Shiho didn't actually do anything wrong in this case.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She was just trying to do something for our band all by herself and I was just worried about what would happen to her if she went through with it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I told her that I didn't want her to suffer on her own and asked if I could help out somehow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't know that part...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: So you had an argument, but also found a solution you both could agree on...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. So please, don't tell anyone else about what I just said.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Of course! Not one peep.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: As long as you're fine with that, Honami. I guess it really isn't something we should be telling others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, I was really surprised when I heard that you were who they were talking about, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, this is Honami Mochizuki we're talking about☆

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It really is important to clearly tell someone what you're feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I don't enjoy raising my voice the way I did...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But it was something I had to do. Len was right. We aren't going to agree on everything and I have to express myself whenever a situation calls for it.)
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That should be everything Shiho told me to work on today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd really like it if Shiho could see how I'm doing before practice and make sure I've fixed everything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She should still be awake...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll send her a message now to let her know about practice tomorrow and...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see. Where's my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? A DM from Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...
The next day
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry, did I keep you waiting?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you're fine. Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ahh... The smell of the apple pies here is always so nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I really wasn't expecting you to buy some for me just for helping you sell those tickets.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You did me a favor, so I have to pay you back somehow. Get as many as you like, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, but I sort of forced you into letting me help you sell them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you're not gonna order any, I will... How does twenty sound?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Hold on! I love the apple pies here, but that might be a bit excessive!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'd say ten is my limit...
I don't want to think about what would happen if I ate more than that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ten still seems like a lot...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But ten's okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
W-Wait, Shiho!
You buying these for me still doesn't seem right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, how about you, Ichika, Saki and I split these?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, okay... In that case...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Let's do that.
Excuse me. Can I get ten apple pies?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Nom, nom...
Mmm... So good!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's still pretty hot... Oh, but I like how they don't use too much sugar.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. See what I mean? The dough's nice and crispy on the outside, but gooey on the inside...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
The apples still taste so fresh too.
It's really hard for me to stop at just one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. I can tell.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That one you had is already gone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here, have another.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shiho.
I really enjoyed that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're welcome. Thanks again for helping me sell those tickets, and not telling Ichika or Saki about what we were doing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, you don't need to thank me.
I'm just happy that you let me help in the end.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I was so nervous about asking you that time, but I'm so glad I did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've become so strong...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? I have...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, that time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was sure that if I pushed you away hard enough that you'd leave me alone, but I was wrong...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not only that, you've come a long way as a drummer in terms of your confidence.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know how to assert yourself now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's because you and the others have always been there for me. You're all there to support me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I couldn't have helped form our band or lead my class for the choir recital if it were just me.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And you, Shiho, you're always there to encourage me and help me build my confidence.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess so...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I'm going to keep doing my best to learn how to support all of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So please, ask me for help if you ever think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, I will.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, wanna head over to the studio?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You want me to see if you fixed what we talked about yesterday, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's so warm out today.
Warm enough to actually go outside.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, hanging some laundry or bedding outside today would make it feel so fluffy afterward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a mom, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Haha... I couldn't help it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I totally get what you mean, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It'd be great to hang some bedding out to dry and take a nap on it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: While it's drying? How does that work?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, I should tell Ichika about Ms. Yoisaki before I forget.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, about the person you asked Asahina to hand that CD to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
You've been doing housework for that person?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I was surprised to find out as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, Ms. Yoisaki...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you like to meet my friend...? That is, if you'd like to...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: M-Me meeting her?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Again, you don't have to if don't like...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'd like to thank her for the CD, so would you mind setting us up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? You asked her to meet us...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I expected her to turn it down, but she ended up agreeing to it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's great, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Especially since you said that you missed your chance to ask Asahina about this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Exactly. Thank you, Honami.
I really don't know what else to say.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you don't have to thank me like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel a little bad about not telling you about Ms. Yoisaki even though I had known for a while now that she composes her own music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You would know what since you've been to her house.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but only for work. I felt that divulging anything personal about her would've been unprofessional.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As a standard rule, yes, so I believe you were doing the right thing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But... At the same time, she might've been able to help Ichika and Saki with their songwriting if I'd asked sooner.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (There was no way for me to help them, but Ms. Yoisaki may've been able to...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't fret so much about that, Hona!
I have a feeling that not asking was the right answer, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, if someone else came in to save the day, I probably wouldn't have put as much effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Knowing that we could ask someone for help might've had the opposite effect...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly! It's our band and our song, so we should be the ones doing all the work♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, all of you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You should also make sure to wear an outfit that makes you stand out. You know, to make sure they know it's you♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, their little encounter at the CD shop's the only time they've seen each other, right? What if they don't really remember what you look like?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And if you ever get stuck during a conversation, you could just talk about your outfit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... But I'm still not very good at talking to people I'm meeting for the first time. I'm really not sure if I'll be able to make use of your advice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Would you mind joining us, Honami?
I honestly don't have much confidence in keeping a conversation going with her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you mind joining us for this? I honestly don't really get out much, so I may have some trouble keeping a conversation going.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hehe. They both asked me the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. Ms. Yoisaki actually asked me the same thing, so I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You will?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. So you have nothing to worry about, Ichika. But I do suggest having some questions ready beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I will! Thank you so much, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're welcome.
Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I'll start cleaning as usual.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, can I ask you to come up with what to make again...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That was delicious.
Thank you again, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you like it.
And your tea's just about ready. Here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Today, I made some Jasmine tea.
Its aroma should have a nice, relaxing effect to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it smells very nice.
Without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And thank you again for the flowers.
You said this is a gerbera?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I chose a white one today because it snowed the last time we met.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ah, I see. But it still feels strange how a single flower can brighten up a room like this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad she likes what I brought. I'll have to thank Ichika later.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
I forgot to tell you something the other day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My friend who “knows quite a lot about flowers” is actually Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Ah...
I knew it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You did? Oh, did you figure it out while talking to her...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I had a feeling after reading her lyrics and hearing the way she spoke.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think what I'm trying to say is...
It suits her style, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's always so kind, gentle and quietly watching over us. I suppose she is like a flower in that sense...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, if I recall correctly... Didn't you say that she knows so much about flowers because she visited your childhood friend in the hospital every day...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. It feels like it's been ages since I told you that. I'm surprised you remembered.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remember because she sounded like an incredibly nice person...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And she turned out to be just that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for showering my childhood friend with such kind words.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ah, you're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And please allow me to thank you again for agreeing to meet with Ichika the other day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It felt like I was asking a lot of you then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But Ichika was so happy about being able to meet you, so I don't regret my decision even a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I should give my thanks as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Meeting Hoshino, as well as getting a chance to talk with you, her and Mafuyu, was very nice. I had a wonderful time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So thank you too, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so glad you enjoyed everything, Ms. Yoisaki...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but I also promised to meet her again sometime...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have a lot of work to do right now, so that may not happen for a while.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's perfectly fine.
We're busy practicing for a show right now too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I appreciate you extending the offer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Until then, I'll be looking forward to our next meeting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too! I can't wait!
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This one...!
No, it's the joker!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Third place is mine this time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That makes Shiho the winner of this round.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
Your poker face is way too good, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you're just having a hard time hiding what you're thinking. To be fair, you've always been like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hey!!
You girls having a fun New Year's Eve?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Rin...
You really shouldn't jump out and startle people like that.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys came.
Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Where are Len and KAITO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Those two said that they didn't want to intrude on our all-girls party. They should be playing something together right now.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But they did say that they'd pop in for the shrine visit.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's understandable... It would be more fun with them here, but an all-girls party it is!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah☆>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but we won't really be able to play cards together... We may want to choose something better...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, but is there anything that we can all play...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
How about this?
“The Great Animal Race - Dog Edition”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A board game?
Sounds fun! What are the rules?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, I'll start explaining!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We each play a dog that's trying to collect as many treats as it can. You'll work your way towards the goal by ideally landing on as many treat spaces as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Normally, the person who gets there first wins, but the winner here is determined by which dog has the most treats.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I think I get it!
So just collect as many treats as we can, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That means it's best to roll ones and twos if we are going to try to land on all these treat spaces...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but reaching the goal before your opponents can also yield some bonus treats.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Ah, that makes things interesting. We won't really know who wins until it's all over.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah... Hm?
Is each piece designed differently...?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. As it happens, each piece represents a different breed.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I see a Corgi, a Beagle... And a Siberian Husky.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which breed will also play an important role throughout the game. For instance, some spaces give certain breeds an advantage while disadvantaging others.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see.
Whoever made this must've put a ton of thought into it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But since this is our first time, why don't we all just pick a breed we like?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hmm...
How are we all going for pieces?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Rin and I are the Corgi!
I love how its bottom looks like a fluffy loaf of bread♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And its big ears just add to its cuteness♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: MEIKO and I will be the Siberian Husky.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <This one looks like it means business.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm having a hard time saying no to this Beagle. It looks so cute, but also very smart.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. I love how droopy its ears are too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <How about the Shiba...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Ah, an excellent choice...
The perfect mix of astuteness and affection.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. Just like you, Miku.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <A Shiba Miku for Miku-P☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What in the world is a Shiba Miku...?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Aren't Shibas the cutest?
I own one, so I can't get enough of them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We seem to be choosing breeds in pairs, so why don't we play in teams of two this time...? The team with the highest total will be the winner.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's do our best, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
There's nowhere but the top for us, Sakki!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, let's get the dice out and... Hold on, I didn't realize how many different kinds of spaces are on this board.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? What do the ones with dogs drawn on them mean?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, those are lucky spaces.
You get two treats if you happen to be the right breed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, if you land on one of these card squares, you'll have to draw a card and do whatever it says.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Interesting. I'd like to see what these cards have in store for us!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: One second... Here you are!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Let's see... “Look! A Tunnel! All breeds besides Huskies move forward two spaces”... Oh, because Huskies are too big!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Was choosing a Husky a bad choice...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, not necessarily.
Some cards and spaces give bigger breeds an advantage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to know.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you should see this card.
“Bark like your dog's piece until your next turn.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh...
I'd rather not draw that one...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Since this game's all about treats, why don't we give ourselves some treats to eat each time we land on one of these spaces?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. That means I'll have to eat everything you brought today, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?! No way! Not happening!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Alright, let's get started with those rules included!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, it's a card space. Let's see... “There's a big fence that only Huskies can jump over. Move forward two spaces if you're a Husky.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yay!
Nice draw, Shiho!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, we're up next... Oh, a dog space! We got a treat, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That means it's our turn now.
We landed on a card space. Would you mind drawing for us, Honami?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sure... Huh?!
B-But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh no...!
“Bark like your dog's piece until your next turn”...!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That means you two have to bark like a Shiba until your next turn...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Awesome!
Alright, Miku, let's hear it♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! We get to hear Hona and Miku bark like dogs!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I-I'm so sorry, Honami...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-It's okay, Miku!
We'll get through this!
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyone want any juice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Woof...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: More juice! You got it♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's getting pretty late.
Isn't it past your bedtime, Miku?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, we get it!! You can stay up, Miku-P!!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Lay off, you two. That's bordering on bullying, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry.
I couldn't help it. They're just so adorable like this.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <As long as you understand... Anyway, I'm next. Mind rolling for me, Shiho?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure. It's a four, which means you have to draw a card. Let's see what it says...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What's it say?
What does she have to do?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Quick conference...
MEIKO, about this card...

rows.Speaker: Rin

rows.Speaker: Rin

rows.Speaker: Len

rows.Speaker: Saki

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Line: Once I get home, Honami, I promise to have dinner, take a bath and go straight to bed tonight.

rows.Line: Thank you! Please get in a good night's rest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We don't have as much time as we usually do to practice, so this may be a close one.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And I may need to ask Ichika and the others to cut back on shifts and such...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm sure we all want Hanano and her brother to hear our song.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Also, I want to do everything I can for those two since they're calling themselves Leo/need fans.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(So, I want our song to reach them.
I want our show to touch their hearts...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Which means we'll need a good practice schedule that can help us put on the best performance possible.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Line: (Putting together a good schedule's one thing, but isn't there anything else I can do to help...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes! There is something I can do!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start working on it when I get home!

rows.Line: Would you mind telling me what's bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: I've loved the sea and fish for as long as I can remember. So much so that I sort of want to do something related for a living.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: And when we went to the Seaside School, I got to meet someone who teaches marine biology at a university.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: After asking them all about what they do, my desire to become a researcher like them only grew stronger...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: But when I mentioned that to my mom, she told me that I should find a better job with more stable pay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is it tough to keep food on the table as a researcher?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Not if you work for a lab at a school or company... However, in order for that to happen, you have to go to graduate school and produce good research...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: And in terms of the marine biology research I want to do, I have a feeling that finding a lab where I can work is going to be very difficult...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: My mom had to work really hard when she was young, so I'm guessing she doesn't want me to go through what she did...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: She even added, “It doesn't have to be you,” and, “It doesn't sound like meaningful research, so I wouldn't bother.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What...?
That's not true at all...!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Thank you, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: I've been thinking about it a lot lately and can't get myself to talk more about this with my mom. Not only that, I'm too scared that the teacher's going to say the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
But I'm really glad...
You seem to really understand how I feel, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: You and your childhood friends are in a band and trying to go pro together, right? I was sure that you'd be willing to hear me out since you're also chasing after a big dream...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Oh, that's the bell...
Again, thank you for your time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait! If it's alright with you, can we talk again...?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't know if I can do anything to help, but I feel like things won't get any better if we don't act...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Mochizuki...
Sure, I really appreciate it...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm not seeing Miku or the others anywhere. I guess it is very late...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And we ended up having to wait until tomorrow to talk after not being able to find time today...)

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: She even added, “It doesn't have to be you,” and, “It doesn't sound like meaningful research, so I wouldn't bother.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What can I do to help...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's going to affect her future, so I have to tread carefully...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And despite how uncomfortable she feels about it, I believe she should talk to her mom or the teacher...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I asked to help without thinking much about it... Am I really up to this task?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Did I do something I shouldn't have again...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was hoping that some stargazing would help me come up with some ideas... If only things were so easy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Did something flash just now...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, there's something rolling around over there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is this...? A ball...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-What?! So bright...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, who could that be visiting this place so late at night?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? There's no one here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There isn't? That's strange...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought I just sensed someone coming here, but I may've just been imagining things...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-Is this a jungle...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I was on the rooftop of the school in SEKAI just now! How did I end up here...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, if I stop Untitled...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, where's my phone...?!
I could've sworn that I put it in my pocket.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Does this mean...? Am I stuck here...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-Is somebody there...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Miku...? Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: MEIKO...? Rin...? KAITO...? Len...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Seriously, where am I...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(My phone's gone...
Maybe I dropped it somewhere close by...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hmm... These glowing plants are very pretty, but kind of scary at the same time... I should probably avoid touching them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm? What's this? A piece of paper...?
No, it feels like leather...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, there's a small star mark in the center.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Could this be some kind of map?
Does this star represent the exit?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But there aren't any paths or landmarks... I don't even know where I am right now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And I'll just get lost if I start walking around without a plan...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I even remember hearing how it's better to just stay put when you lose your way on a mountain.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika and the others may come and find me if I wait here...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Tomorrow, once they realize that I'm not at school, they should figure out that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No... That's not the solution...
Mom, Ichika, everyone... They're going to be so worried...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
But I'm really glad...
You seem to really understand how I feel, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I promised to talk to her tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have to find a way back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I should put something on the ground to remind myself that this is my starting point.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In terms of paths... I should see if some animals made any... I don't have much to go on right now, but that should lower my chances of getting lost...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm seeing signs of animals having passed this way... I can start by following this little trail...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can't even see where I started now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And the star on this map-like drawing is still puzzling me... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, a line's been drawn in the lower lefthand corner. This wasn't here before...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, is there where I've walked...?
If so, I should be able to find my way toward the star!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (There's no guarantee that the star is where the exit is, but I feel much more hopeful now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew... My surroundings still look more or less the same, but I'm making progress toward where the star is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Just a little more to go...

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: Ho...mi...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A voice? Is someone calling for me...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Could it be Ichika and the others...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've moved away from the star a little bit... But that person's voice was definitely coming from somewhere around here...)

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “Seriously, Honami's such a bootlicker.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “She always just smiles and nods while listening to someone's problems.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wh-What are these voices...?
Where are they coming from...?

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “She makes people feel like they owe her so much while feeling all high and mighty. What a phony.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, that wasn't what I was...

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “Then, what are you gonna tell that girl tomorrow? How you think her dream's so wonderful? How you're gonna help her out so much?”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Wait...

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line:
“You can't do anything.”
“And yet, you're this nosey.”

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “Can't you see that nobody wants your phony kindness?”

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Classmate
rows.Line: Whose side are you on?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I just...
Hey! Where are you...?!
Honami!
Honami! Say something if you can hear us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That voice... Len?
MEIKO and Miku too...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Is it really them...?
Did they come looking for me...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Calm down...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not the old me anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it sounds like you already know what you want to do, Honami. You genuinely want to be there for Shiho, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can at least say that I don't think resolve and commitment aren't things you can learn about from others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think it means to be kind, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't care if nobody wants my kindness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate the fact that others are willing to open up to me about their problems, but that's not why I'm kind to them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm kind to them because I just can't leave them be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know that I can't always actually help them, but I can at least encourage them by letting them know that I'm there for support!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I'm going to show my kindness to my classmate once more by talking with her tomorrow!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm...? W-Wait... I'm back on the rooftop...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wah! M-Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you okay? You're not hurt, are you?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Relax, Miku...
As far as I can tell, she's perfectly fine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. Also, I'm sure Honami's still confused regarding what just happened.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, that “fragment of a feeling” sent me to a different SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. However, I was surprised to hear that you were sent into a jungle. I wonder whose feelings those were.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: On top of it all, you vanished and left only your phone behind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But even if you had it with you, fragments act as the entrances to their respective SEKAI, so you wouldn't have been able to use Untitled to get back.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, here's your phone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
You too, MEIKO, Len...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If they hadn't come looking for me, I probably would've stayed stuck in that place...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming to find me...
Thank you all so very much...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was no big deal.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. We're just glad to see that you're safe.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Good morning, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
I need to apologize about yesterday.
You probably weren't expecting me to dump the story of my life on you like that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I'm really glad that you did.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I thought about it quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: First, I think you need to take a hard look at what you're feeling.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: What I'm feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's something one of my bandmates said a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're trying to go pro, so we can't be happy with just being in a band together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have to be prepared to fully commit ourselves to our music.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Commit...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I'd like you to ask yourself again to see if you truly want to become a marine biologist.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And, even if it means butting heads with your mom, whether you will be able to pursue your dream without relenting or having any regrets.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Right...
Because it isn't easy to make your dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Take me for instance. I'm reminded of just how far I still need to go each time our band plays a show.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mochizuki.
I'll take a step back and think about what I actually want to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Um... If it's alright with you, I'd like it if we could talk more again sometime...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. I promise to support you until you find the answer.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I mean, that's what classmates and friends are for, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Mochizuki...
Thank you so much...!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're doing great, Hona!
You've been staying in rhythm on your bass drum while even hitting all the backbeats!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nice work! You sounded amazing just now, Hona! You've come so far in just two weeks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've been recording myself during these training sessions to do a before and after comparison... And I was amazed to hear how different I sound now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This means I should do okay tomorrow when we all play together, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
You just gotta keep this up and keep building confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, come in!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... Is now a good time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm? What's up?
Aren't you assigned to Shih today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I am, but Shiho finished practicing a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was wondering how you were doing since you ran late today...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Rin told me before we started practicing about how she first went to see Shiho by mistake.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha...
B-But it all worked out because Hona's such a great student!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay. As long as you're okay with it, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not a problem!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you finally get to play as a band tomorrow. Good luck...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll do my best to show how far I've come!
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another exhausting day...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...
But we finally get to play as a band tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'm sure the others have made significant improvements.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's been so long since we last played together too. Not once since we started doing these training sessions...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope it goes okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho's gotten a lot better too.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Am I going to be able to keep up with her...? Will I be the foundation that supports our band...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's all going to become clear tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If I can't...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We might not be able to get our song to resonate with Saku or that live house's audience...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The promise I made with Ichika and Saki might...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho honestly believes that we possess the ability to prove Saku wrong and get our music to resonate with everyone at that live house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's do our best... Let's give it everything we have.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know that we've all been doing our best until now to put on good performances...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we're going to have to do even more this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll need to do absolutely everything in our power so that Shiho will be able to play without holding back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do absolutely everything we possibly can during these next two weeks to give Shiho a chance to play at her very best!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Leo/need! Here we...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Go!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We may also have to show Shiho just how committed we are tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no... My hands are starting to shake...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay... Just calm down...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I understand how you all feel.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we've gotta do this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she's right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(We have to do this...
No matter what.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll be fine. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So...
I'm gonna do my best tomorrow!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness our show went well...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We managed to get through to the audience with our song and receive Saku's acknowledgment.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (After our last show, we didn't talk much on our way home because of how bad we all felt. But this time...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't wait for our after party!
Oh, wanna go buy snacks and drinks for it right now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I don't mind, Saki...
But I have a feeling that you're gonna start chowing down on them after you get home.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Especially since you've probably worked up a nice appetite.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! No, I wouldn't do such a thing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad to see that they're all enjoying themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We should also thank Miku and the others for helping us out the way they did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Hmm... What do you think we should do...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know♪
Why don't we play live for them?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they might really enjoy that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, we're doing another show during our after party?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, why not?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sure, they got to see our show.
But this is our chance to put one on just for them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I like it. Oh, they might enjoy it so much that they'll want to join in on the fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that'd be awesome♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I agree that it's a good idea...
But it kinda defeats the purpose of having an after party.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Honami
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not against this idea...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But since they all tutored us one-on-one, I feel like we should thank them individually somehow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, that reminds me of how they always show a lot of interest in the snacks we bring to our after parties!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's right. Miku's been showing an interest in cotton candy lately and has been asking me every time if we brought any.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Len and KAITO also seem to be pretty particular in terms of which snacks they like to eat!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? You're so observant, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! I'm the one who actually goes out and buys the snacks after all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know which are most popular and which everyone likes♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, do you think it'd make Miku and the others happy if we got them the snacks they really like?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, there's this one thing that Rin always talks about when we practiced together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You mean that super sour gum?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I heard that as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. There was a pack of them in the snacks we brought the other day. She split it with Len and KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But Rin ended up getting the really sour one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha.
I guess Rin told everyone that story.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Looks like it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Speaking of snacks...
During our break, I remember Luka saying how it'd be nice to have some cookies that go well with tea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO said that she wanted to try some super sweet or super spicy snacks!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've been bringing over snacks and such so often lately that it's become a part of their normal conversations.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, even during our training sessions, we usually either talked about snacks or played our instruments whenever we took a break.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This entire month was filled with stuff like that, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it was.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, to thank Miku and the others for helping us practice for a whole month, let's gift them their favorite snacks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm all for that♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, we'll need to go out and buy each of their favorites.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right!
Kindergarten

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The old man and lady lived happily ever after. The end.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That concludes our little story.
Did you all enjoy it?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah, it was really good!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: And you're a really good reader, Ms. Honami!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah, I love your voice! It's so kind and gentle!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I love your voice, Hona! It's so kind and gentle!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (When's the last time I read a picture book for others? I remember reading one for Saki when she was in the hospital.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She even commented on how gentle my voice is and asked me to read quite a few of them.)

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Ms. Honami, can you read “Little Red Riding Hood” for us next?!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: No, read “Momotaro”!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's read both of them.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: You mean it? You'll read “Momotaro”?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. I promise to read it, so there's no need to worry.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Okay! I'll try to be patient.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's very grown-up of you. Thank you for offering to wait.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: No fair! I want a head pat too!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Me three!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Huh...?!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Ms. Honami! Let's make this puzzle together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A puzzle...?!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: No, Ms. Honami's gonna read some stories to us!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah, she even promised to read “Momotaro”!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Ms. Honami, let's go outside and play tag! We're all gonna work together to catch Ms. Emu!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
W-W-Wait...!
I'm still not done reading these stories to everyone...

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: No, stop! She's not done reading to us yet!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: E-Everybody, let's all just settle down...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I-If this keeps up, they're all going to end up fighting...! Wh-What am I supposed to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. The children seem to have taken quite a liking to you, Ms. Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Oh, hello...!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Everyone, I have a question for all of you. How many of Ms. Honami are there?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: One!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: That's right. So, what should we do if we want her to read stories, make puzzles and play tag?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Do them in order...?

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes, we'll have to decide on an order.
And I'm sure Ms. Honami will play with all of you if we figure one out.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Do you think she'd break her promise?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: No, she wouldn't!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Exactly. So, let's come up with an order that'll make it easier for Ms. Honami to play with all of us!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was amazing! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome.
You can take it from here, yes?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Playtime's almost over.
That means we'll be painting soon...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll be fine. I practiced so much with Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Did you get a chance to play with all the children, Ms. Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I did. They behaved themselves so well after you stepped in to help.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: The visitors who come to these job shadowings are always popular with the children, but you two are on a different level. They just can't get enough of you.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
I mean, look at Ms. Emu.
She's outside running around with so many of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line:
Gwah-hah-hah!
If you don't run, Ms. Emu's gonna get you!

rows.Speaker: Kindergarteners' Voices
rows.Line: No, she's coming towards us!

rows.Speaker: Kindergarteners' Voices
rows.Line: Run! Run away! Haha!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They all seem to be enjoying themselves very much.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: See what I mean? They all love you this much, so I'm sure our painting activity will go very smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Did she notice how nervous I am about that...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I promise to do my best with them during our painting activity!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
That's the spirit.
Anyway, I'll go get Ms. Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This teacher's such an amazing person...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I'm also a teacher today, so I also have to do everything I can!)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hoonnaa!
Let's go home together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all here!
Yes, let's!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We were assigned so much homework again today. I'll have to get that out of the way somehow before practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I should get some done too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Same. I still have to write the report for my shadowing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Hona, you taught some kindergartners how to paint, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, can we see that picture of you with all of them again?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course. Just give me a second to find it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's so cute.
All the kids have huge smiles on their faces!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and the wall you all painted turned out really adorable too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. The idea was to make it look like a zoo.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But then, Emu said, “We should make it an amusement park where we can play with animals!” As a result, it turned into a wonderful work of art.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That explains why there's a Ferris wheel.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, if you want a better look at the wall... Here, it's much clearer in this photo.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, you're right!
Let's have a closer look...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Honami, this person who's only partly in the frame... Is it Ena?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, she's in the same group as Ms. Yoisaki, the person who I cook and clean for from time to time. Ms. Yoisaki introduced me to her, and she taught me how to draw.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Looks like she's a pretty good artist.
I mean, the bear behind her looks way more real compared to all the other animals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she initially tried to draw animals in a cute and cartoonish way like everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the kindergartners asked her to “draw a cool and scary-looking bear”, and she went along by sort of pulling out all the stops.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like something Ena would do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, she also painted a pair of wolves. One cartoonish and the other more realistic, like the one her little brother saw at the zoo and became scared of.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I've heard a little about her little brother. I'm also curious as to what this wolf was like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Aha, Hona, found yours!
It's a...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hippo...? No, a crocodile...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Correct!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I practiced drawing crocodiles quite a lot, but I realized in the end that I should paint one that's true to me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see no problem with that. You can instantly tell that you painted it, Honami, and it really draws your attention. I probably couldn't get that effect even if I really tried.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I also really love the way you painted it, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (At first, I sort of dreaded having to paint during my shadowing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami, mind drawing a crocodile for us? You know, how you normally would...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What?
But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
Yes, some people might laugh at it because it doesn't look real...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm sure someone will understand as long as you try your best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Ena was right.
The children really liked what I painted. And...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, wait...! Hona!
This cat wearing a scarf... Didn't you read me this same story when we were little?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, good eye!
I was reminded of that while I read to the children, and decided to draw it out of pure nostalgia.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A cat wearing a scarf...?
So it wasn't a snake wrapping itself around a rat...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought it was a swim ring...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A-Also, didn't we take a big bag full of picture books during one of our hospital visits when we were in elementary school?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember it being really heavy. We crammed so many books in that we had to help you carry them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's incredible. You all really remembered?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. I remember you reading us a few stories after we lugged it over.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me too... I vaguely remember blurting out things like, “Why didn't they do this?”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I remember you shouting, “Just say it already,” or, “Grow a backbone,” and all sorts of other stuff!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I painted it from memory, so it ended up looking very different from the actual character.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You think so? I recognized it immediately.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I couldn't really tell...
But you really do have a unique style, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They're all smiling after seeing that I painted.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm so glad I went on that shadowing.)
Live House

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello.
We're Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We'll be performing in the next event.
We hope you'll come and watch.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wow, I've handed out so many flyers today. I should meet back up with the others to...)

rows.Speaker: Female Spectator A
rows.Line: Excuse me. Can I have one of those?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
We're also selling tickets to our show. If you like...

rows.Speaker: Female Spectator A
rows.Line:
Yes, we plan on buying some.
We really liked your last show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Female Spectator B
rows.Line:
You guys played with anemone, right?
That was so awesome.

rows.Speaker: Female Spectator A
rows.Line:
Yeah, anemone's great and all...
But your band, Leo/need... That one song you played really hit home with me.

rows.Speaker: Female Spectator A
rows.Line:
I really want to hear it again.
So, good luck with your next show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you!
We'll do our best!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That went great!
I handed out so many flyers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too.
At this rate, we shouldn't have any problems reaching our ticket quota.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we should be all set by the time our show rolls around. Handing these flyers out must've really done the trick.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was actually approached by some people who saw our last show and really seemed to enjoy it. They even bought tickets to our next one... That made me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I got told the same thing by some other people! They said that they liked the way we performed... I feel so pumped now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It wasn't all that smooth, but performing somewhere other than our usual live house seems to have been the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's keep this up, play at more places and show everyone that Leo/need is here to stay.

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we're on track to meet our ticket quota.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It really feels like we're making good progress every day. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Female Spectator A
rows.Line:
Yeah, anemone's great and all...
But your band, Leo/need... That one song you played totally hit home with me.

rows.Speaker: Female Spectator A
rows.Line:
I really want to hear it again.
So, good luck with your next show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I couldn't be happier...
We practiced so hard to play in a way we all felt good about, and the audience responded really well as a result...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we can't stop here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's like Shiho said.
We have to keep doing everything we can to get our name out there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But... How do we actually do that...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh...?
This poster... It wasn't here yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“Shibuya Festa”...?
It looks like a big event. They're going to have a variety of stalls set up and a special stage...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Saki would love this.
I'll tell her about it tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But this stage...
Are they inviting professional musicians to play?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What?
“Now accepting applications for general participants”...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Does that mean we can play here...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it says it's going to be at Nonogi Park. That means it's going to be a fairly big stage. If we do get the opportunity to play somewhere like that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll really be able to get our name out there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But it's such a big event...
We've never done anything like this before. I'm honestly a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line: <Hello, this is the Shibuya Festa Operations Team. Thank you for contacting us.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... Thank you for taking my call. I just came across a poster for Shibuya Festa today and had a question regarding it...

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line: <Yes, how may I help you?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, about this stage...
You seem to be accepting applications for general participants. Does that mean amateur bands are allowed to enter?

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line:
<Yes, of course.
We're looking for acts ranging from musicians and dancers to street performers of all kinds. The more genres, the better.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...!
Then... If I decide to enter, how would I go about applying for this event?

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line:
<Oh, you can apply by phone.
If you're ready, I'll take down your information now.>

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line: <However, there's been quite a bit of interest in this event, so we are starting to run out of time slots...>

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line: <If you don't mind, I'll check to see how many are left...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...!
I'd appreciate that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I see. We aren't the only ones looking for an opportunity like this to perform in front of a large audience...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I hope we can still get a spot...)

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line:
<Thank you for your patience.
There just happens to be one slot left!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-One...?!

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line:
<Yes, you called just in time.
If you like, I can take down your information now...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Uh... P-Please give me one second! I need to discuss this with my friends first...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I called back in a couple of minutes?

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line:
<Yes, of course.
However, we're accepting applications on a first-come-first-serve basis...>

rows.Speaker: Operations Team
rows.Line: <If another person applies before you call back, we'll have no choice but to accept their application over yours. I hope you'll understand.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I... I understand!
I promise to call right back!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-There's only one spot left...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I need to hurry...! I have to get ahold of the others now!
Shibuya Festa - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's celebrate us putting on an awesome show by getting the most out of Shibuya Festa!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't believe how much energy you still have, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, me neither.
We literally just finished playing too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was excited about performing today, but I've been looking forward to enjoying the festival with all of you even more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we still have some time until Tsukasa's show starts, so let's check out the stalls on Main Street!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
Kohane and her team won't be performing for a while either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Miku and the others also said that they wanted to see what's going on, so let's give them a holler.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line: Okay!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wow! Look at all the stalls!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<And so many people.
Actually, we should be able to blend in just fine.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This is so much fun. It really feels like a festival. I'm seeing quite a few food stalls... Oh, what's that? A shooting gallery? Sounds interesting.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<A shooting gallery...?
I'm interested too.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But I wanna check out all the food!
The girls said that they'd buy some for us, so we should see what deliciousness they have available!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It sounds like they're enjoying everything already.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I totally get how they feel!
I mean, it's a big festival! How can you not get excited?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is a pretty big event.
On top of all the usual stalls you see at festivals, I'm noticing some that I've never seen before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Like that one...
“The Punching Game! It's great stress relief!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What in the world...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've never seen anything like that before either. Why don't we go take a look?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Punching Doll: 200 yen - All you can punch for five minutes”...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
“All you can punch”...?
That's an oddly violent description...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It did say that it's great for stress relief. Oh, these big balloon animals must be the punching dolls...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, they look like the inflatable toys you see kids playing with at the pool. But probably more durable.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This looks like fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I wanna give it a try!
What do you girls think?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll try if you're going to, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
But I'm not sure if I'll be able to make full use of them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <What about you, Shiho?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not that interested.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I'd feel bad about punching innocent animals...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so adorable, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm gonna really sock it to them! Hey, mister, the three of us each want to give it a go!

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line:
You got it!
You have five minutes starting... Now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's do this!
Eat this...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa!
It stood right back up!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, it bounces back like a spring. That means you have to sort of dodge it if you hit it really hard.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now, it's my turn...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, Ichika, your form's so beautiful.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<And she really unloaded on it!
No fair! This looks like way too much fun...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <How do you feel, Honami? Ready?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A-Alright...
I'll give it a try... How's this?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, Honami, you're quite the...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And this!
And this! And this! And this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hona?!

rows.Speaker: Stall Worker
rows.Line: Wow! Young lady, you've got some good form! Do you have a lot of martial arts experience?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Th-That was incredible...
You looked like a veteran fighter just now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(That was so strange...
I was hitting it in rhythm for some reason. It felt like I was playing the drums just now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This is so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um, Honami...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Have you been feeling a lot of stress lately?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm not sure stress has anything to do with this...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was so much fun...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't realize you had this kind of hidden talent.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm not talented at all.
I just hit it like I was playing the drums.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Still, Hona, that was amazing!
You were able to use the muscle you gained for our last show to good use...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, she might be right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we ended up having so much fun that we sort of forgot about buying food for Miku and the others...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Don't mind us.
We had plenty of fun just watching.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! It looked like so much fun that I wanted to also give it a try!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Some yummy food would also be nice♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's see what the other stalls have to offer.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo! I can't wait to see♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, wait just a second!
That stall over there... Its sign says, “Ultra Yoyo Gold Fishing”!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
U-U-Uhh, right!
We're supposed to get food for the others!
School SEKAI
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone. I think that should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okey dokey! Tomorrow's finally here! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. As soon as homeroom finishes, we'll head over to Class B.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone. I'll be waiting for all of you there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? What's tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honami's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll be having a party and invited a whole bunch of friends!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You should've said something earlier. We could've prepared something nice for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I guess there's not much we can do now, but...is there anything else we could possibly do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, if you all have time after the party tomorrow, you guys should come over here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We want to throw a celebration for you too, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? I would love that! Thank you!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Honami

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Exactly. They're living creatures, so I'd feel awful if I started making everyone else fill in and take care of them for me.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I remember talking with Minori about some that looked really cool and abstract...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line: (Is she talking about the ones I drew...?)

rows.Line: (I'm less against drawing now, but I still feel a little embarrassed when I think about people seeing my work...)

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I get to play a small part in brightening up people's days, which makes the effort I put in worth it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really admire how you can work so hard for the sake of others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I just like doing those sorts of tasks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, as you pointed out earlier, this committee isn't as involved as some of the other ones...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, since you've taken an interest in joining, it'd be nice if we could be on it together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I do think it would be fun to be on this committee, and it not being as involved as some of the other ones is a big plus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But above all else, I'd feel a lot better knowing that you'd be there with me, Honami.

rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Line: I have to learn to walk before I can run, but my hope is that you'll be willing to show me the ropes.

rows.Line: What brings you here?

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Sorry for the sudden intrusion.>

rows.Line:

rows.Line: <Okay, that's good to hear. Still...>

rows.Line: <From what I saw just now, you seemed to be having trouble focusing on what you were doing...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Was it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Is that question really nagging at you?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... I've been giving it some thought, but I'm really struggling to find an answer...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I decided to do some practicing on my own in the hopes that taking a hard look at my instrument would lead me to a clue.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I didn't get anywhere since my mind kept jumping between thinking and practicing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I understand how you feel, since being told to relax or not be so anxious usually ends up having the opposite effect.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, true...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Then, why not try looking at it this way?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's something very important, so try thinking about it at your own pace.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You always think about what's best for those around you. But there's also what's best for you. A pace that suits you, Honami...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A pace that suits me...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, your path of least resistance. The one that doesn't make you stress.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's like the drums. You can't achieve a good sound by hitting the living daylights out of them, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I know you want to find the right answer as soon as possible. But first, you need to take some deep breaths!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <And wait for inspiration to strike!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <How does that sound? Wouldn't it be easier to take it slow?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll take a nice, long bath, relax for a bit and come back to it when I feel ready...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:

Warm yourself up with a long, relaxing soak.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you!
I'll go do that now.
