rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hear that, Max...?

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For now, let's try to catch our breath before the next round starts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's a bench over there that you can use. Why don't you both...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong? Why are you shouting?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
But I just saw Samo... I mean, another Samoyed over there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that.
I think it's also in this competition...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I knew it!
Wow! I didn't know Samoyeds could do disc dog...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your dog did seem to have fun while we practiced, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, are you looking for a Shiba...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... I was hoping to see one make a couple spectacular catches...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But I'm not seeing any.
Does this mean Western dogs are more suited for this sport?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I think it's just that none happen to be in today's competition. I've seen some before at other ones.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm having such a hard time seeing Shibao do anything like this. On top of stubbornly liking to do things at his own pace, he gets bored so easily...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Haha. He did seem like the epitome of his breed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: He really is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My bandmates and I played with him the other day, but he still ended up sitting down after getting bored.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They seemed to really enjoy how I got his face to scrunch up when he refused to move towards the end...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Scrunch up...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's what happens when Shibas refuse to go for a walk or return home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I've heard that their faces become all scrunched when they resist as you pull on their leash.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's a famous phenomenon among dog lovers! I think it's really cute how their breed's characteristics show like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cute? That makes them sound like a handful to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... Yes, he is a handful, and I get a little embarrassed whenever someone sees us in that situation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's natural for things to not go the way either of us want. After all, we're both living creatures.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Even dogs that are the same breed can have totally different personalities and preferences!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, just like us humans...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. I think Max is saying that he agrees.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: No, wait... He might be trying to tell us that he's worked up an appetite after running around so much...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, bone appetit...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that's very clever of you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nothing. I was genuinely impressed by your response.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope your hard work is rewarded with a big feast, Max.

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof...!
Supermarket

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Well, I'm here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still don't know what to make for Saki and Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're bringing something for them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how they're going to be holding a songwriting camp soon?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to show my support by bringing something for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, good point...
I might get them something too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But what...?
Saki and Ichika would probably like it if...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I got them some snacks...?
Something they can both munch on while working?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you know what you're going to bring, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm thinking about making dinner for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Dinner?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm afraid that they're going to forget to eat if they get too focused on songwriting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And even if they've already eaten, they can always have what I make the next day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see.
I think that's a great way for you to show them your support.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I plan on doing what I can for them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still, what should I make...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They'll probably be feeling tired after using their brains to come up with good ideas...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, then... How about curry?
Something with a spicy kick might be just what they'll be craving.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
Curry it is.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, let's start looking for ingredients...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Let's see... It's been a long time, but based on the curry I had at everyone's houses...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Saki's family...
The curry they made was fairly mild.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Also, I remember them saying how it's “loaded with veggies”. They were cut into very big blocks. Hehe. I had a lot of fun that time.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika's family makes theirs a little spicy.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Hehe. This is so nostalgic...
And it's interesting how each family makes their curry a little differently.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, I'm not supposed to be reminiscing right now. Let's see... What do I need...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If I want them to both enjoy it...)

rows.Speaker: Imaginary Ichika
rows.Line: “Make it a little spicy, if you could.”

rows.Speaker: Imaginary Saki
rows.Line:
“What?! I like my curry mild!
Also, can you cut the veggies into big blocks for me♪”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, they won't agree on the spice level...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hmm... What should I do about that...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, that reminds me. Grated apples...
That can help keep things mild.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Plus, apples give curry a richer flavor...)

rows.Speaker: Imaginary Ichika
rows.Line:
“Yes, please.
I like it when curry has a rich taste to it.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That solves that problem...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The sauce will be a little spicy, but the vegetables and grated apples should help make it mild yet flavorful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which I'm hoping they'll both enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... What else do I need...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If I want it to give them a boost of energy, then I suppose beef is the way to go?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I'll head over to the meat section after I pick out my vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Seafood Clerk
rows.Line: Attention, customers! We are now having a limited-time sale!

rows.Speaker: Seafood Clerk
rows.Line:
All seafood is currently thirty percent off!
Please make sure to stop by!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?! Thirty percent off?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And it all looks very fresh.
I almost feel bad receiving such a big discount...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was thinking about buying some beef, but I can't let this opportunity slip...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, seafood curry it is...

rows.Speaker: Seafood Clerk
rows.Line:
Ah, Miss.
If it's curry that you're making, then I recommend the squid, shrimp and scallops over in this corner!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you do?
Wow, they're so big...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Just wait, Saki, Ichika...!
The seafood curry I'm about to make is going to be delicious!)
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're done!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Truly, thank you both for all your hard work.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness Mr. Shindo said it's a good representation of what Leo/need is going to sound like in the future.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a feeling he'd respond well to it. I mean, it is an incredible song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, it's a bit hard to believe that you two ended up having a fight over it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha...
I'm really sorry about that, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry too.
I didn't mean for things to get so heated.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, I think it's important for us to butt heads from time to time since it's sorta normal for bands.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Still, you two hardly ever fight.
Saki and Shiho sometimes have disagreements...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you always acted as the diplomat, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you were always there to smooth things out whenever I couldn't get them to make up, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember!
That was basically how all our arguments got resolved!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that happened a few times, but not that often...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No way! Don't you remember all the arguments we used to have?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do! All of them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For example, that field trip we went on in elementary school. You kept rushing ahead and leaving us all behind...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, when we went to the zoo together, you refused to move from that one spot! We didn't know what to do that time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
Argh! You always do your own thing and forget about the people around you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, look at yourself.
Your whims have driven you for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, this isn't about me!
We're talking about you right—

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
O-Okay, settle down...
Let's all take a deep breath...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's all ancient history, so...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
It's not!
It's not.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, sorry...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do we do, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I also remember what happened at the zoo that time, Shiho. You really did refuse to move from your spot...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yes! Thank you, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I believe we were still in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki's mom took us all that time.
And when we went to the petting area with all the cats, you refused to leave...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Petting area? Cats...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember now.
Saki and I went off to look at the other animals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. We talked with Saki and decided to form two pairs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I ended up staying with Shiho...
But there's a reason why she didn't want to leave.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What reason?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, there was this one kitten who got separated from its mother.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It looked so sad when Shiho found it all by itself, so she decided to help find its parent.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, now I remember...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was sure that I'd be able to find its mom right away, but it wasn't happening... I ended up asking Honami for help...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We were both so relieved after we did reunite them. I remember them also being really happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, how do you remember all this so clearly...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How? Because reuniting them after looking with you for so long made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Shiho!
I should've helped. Then the four of us could've gone around to see the other animals.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's okay since it was my fault for not saying anything. So, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, it was my fault for misunderstanding...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess this means they've made up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well played, Honami.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do we all have a drink ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're all set.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Same here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Here's to the release of Leo/need's debut CD!

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mmm!
You've just gotta have an orange juice after becoming a pro musician!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Didn't you drink the same thing while we were writing that song?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, I remember you drinking orange juice during lunch yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, why am I getting the third degree all of a sudden?! Let's just enjoy the party!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Our CD's been released...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So much happened after Mr. Shindo reached out to us.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We did that solo show and our Thank You Show, then I became the leader of Leo/need...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's already been a long journey, but the days have also gone by so fast.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami...?
What's got you grinning like that? Also, you're all by yourself over here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Did my grin look that funny?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Well, I can't say.
But we can try finding someone else who also saw.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, there you go teasing me again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sorry...
You just looked really happy is all, so I thought I'd ask.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hona! Stop!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You gotta save that for the interview♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, Ms. Hona, as the leader of Leo/need, how do you feel right now?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You're interviewing me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is that plastic bottle supposed to be your microphone?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, Ms. Hona...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't we let her continue?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Actually, I've been wanting to ask you all the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind playing along for a bit, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, how I feel right now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was actually just thinking about all the things that happened after Mr. Shindo discovered us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We threw everything we had at our solo show in order to get our big chance, and I remember being so nervous when I was filling in our contract with my mom...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Those things feel like they happened just yesterday, but now our song's being played all throughout Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
The thought of that excited me so much.
It's like we've really accomplished something, and I can kind of feel proud of what we've done.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, that's why...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I feel really happy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's perfect, Hona! Nice job♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright, next!
Sakki, our eyes just met, so you're up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what?!
There's no way I can follow that interview!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I experienced something so incredible today...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think I see some people on the other platform. It looks like...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, wait! It's not what you think!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What you said to me then made me so happy!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'd become an outcast in class...!
And I absolutely dreaded going to school each day...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you worked up the courage to come talk to me. You showed genuine concern...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You don't know how happy that made me!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was finally able to tell her what I couldn't back then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That wasn't the real Ichika, was it...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Does that mean I should try to tell her...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I think she'd appreciate that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I feel like that'd be really self-serving...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It would feel wrong somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I need to do more.
I need to do something she'll really like...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I know.
Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Let me open the lunch I made now.
Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh wow!
There's so much. It's like we're on a picnic now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
These meatballs look really good.
Oh, so do the sausage octopuses, this spinach and the little omelets.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I also made some rabbits out of apple slices and baked a batch of cookies for dessert.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, look at that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really love your lunches and the cookies you bake, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I can really have all of this?
Shiho probably won't say anything, but Saki might get pouty...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I plan to make some for them and bring it over to practice this weekend, so don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really?
Then, if it's alright with you, I won't be holding back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I made it just for you, so it's all yours.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'm digging in!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Starting with these omelets... No, wait... Saki isn't here to steal them, so I can save them for a change.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, I'll begin with...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Honami
rows.Line: G-Give me my hat back...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Boys
rows.Line: Heh heh. If you really want it back, take it back. Hey, catch!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Ichika
rows.Line: Heeey!!!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Ichika
rows.Line: Leave Honami alone you big bullies!!!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me the other day, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Honami
rows.Line: Umm... My mom and I made a lunch and baked some cookies as a way to thank you. Would you like to have them together?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Ichika
rows.Line:
You did? Yay!
I really love the lunches and cookies your mom makes!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Ichika
rows.Line:
Nom nom...
These meatballs are so good, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I couldn't really think of any other way to thank her besides what I did back then...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mmm! These meatballs are so good, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, nothing's wrong.
I'm glad that I put in the effort to make everything, is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika, I...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I want to become much stronger...
As the leader of Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I want to feel strong... So I can look at you now, the you I saw at the station and the you who helped me that day with my head held high.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (For everyone's sake and my own sake. I'm going to do my best to make that happen.)
After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew... We managed to make it to the meeting on time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought for sure we were going to be late because of how long that assembly was taking.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we sit over in those empty chairs there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do you think we'll be doing today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... We took care of the flower beds in the courtyard last time, so if we follow the same schedule as last year...

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: Alright, I'd like to get this meeting started.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: Many flowers are blooming beautifully now because of the wonderful work you did with their beds last time.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: So, just like last year, I'd like for us to pick a few flowers to put in vases to display around the school.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Does that mean we get to choose the flowers?

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: I'll be assigning you all your own locations, but you'll only have a limited time to choose which flowers you'd like to use. The vases are stored in...
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's try choosing from this bed.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see flowers displayed around the school from time to time, but I didn't know that the cleanup committee was responsible for them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always thought they were pretty, but never really considered who was placing them there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The cleanup committee comes to school very early in the morning to do it, so it makes sense that you wouldn't notice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, different flowers bloom during different parts of the year, so we can't keep the school decorated year-round.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But for that very reason, I'd like to choose a flower that will help brighten up everyone's day, even just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also want to do my best to choose a flower that everyone will think is beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... There really are a lot of different types here. I'm having trouble choosing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How do you always pick them, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, I try to think about how people will feel when they see them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How they're going to feel...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For example, these pink petunias are very cute, so they would cheer people up a little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: On the other hand, this violet scarlet sage has a bit of a calming quality to it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... It is important to think about what people will feel about them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, I want everyone in school to see just how cute flowers can be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, you have your choice of the petunia I just mentioned... Oh, or those white pansies over there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... Their petals are so adorably tiny!
